theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_ll_twl_partition_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (ν : Measure X) (V : ℕ → Set X) (b : X → ℝ) (F : ℕ → X → ℝ) (Flim : X → ℝ), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (V j)) → Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint V) → ν (⋃ j, V j)ᶜ = 0 → Integrable b ν → (∀ k, Integrable (F k) ν) → (∀ k, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, ‖F k x‖ ≤ b x) → Integrable Flim ν → (∀ j, Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in V j, F k x ∂ν) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in V j, Flim x ∂ν))) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, F k x ∂ν) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, Flim x ∂ν))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
